name: Ajiikawa Aya
source:
The Caring Tsundere Student Council President.

Ayunosu Academy, Class 3-E. Serves as the student council president at Ayunosu Academy. She's very caring and popular among the female students.

A dependable person everyone relies on. In public, she respects the protagonist as her teacher, but when it's just the two of them, she calls him a “pervert.”

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
